# PIC (AMD 2914) command trace - INSTRUCTION-B RUN on ND-120 (DELILAH-L)

Ground truth for a gate-level DELILAH interrupt-controller port. Our Amd2914PIC.cs
implements the status fence correctly and RUN completes (no livelock), so every line
below is the HEALTHY behavior the Verilog must reproduce.

Two chips: HI = Am2914 for levels 8-15, LO = levels 0-7 (cascaded).
Per line: `#n CSAR=<oct> SYM=<DELILAH-L label> PIL=<level> INSTR=<PIC op>`, then HI and LO
with each field `Name=after(wasBefore)` - `(wasX)` shown only when the field changed.
Registers OCTAL; flip-flops 0/1. Sense (active-LOW signals captured raw):
  Sta=StatusRegister(fence)  Msk=Mask(1=masked)  Det=Detect(0=pending)  Pri=PriorityEncoder
  Vec=VectorOutput  VHld=VectorHoldingRegister  VClr=VectorClearFF  SOvf=StatusOverflow(0=overflowed)
  IrqE=IrqEnableFF  GrpE=GroupEnable/LGE(active-LOW)  IRQ=Output(0=asserted)  VClm=VectorClaim(0=this chip wins)

PIC instruction names: MCLR CLRIN CLRMB CLRMR CLRVC RDVC RDSTA RDM SETM LDSTA BCLRM BSETM CLRM DISIN LDM ENIN.

## Direct answers to the two open questions (from the first RDVC observed)

First RDVC at CSAR=000017 (), PIL=0:
```
  HI Sta=000 Msk=201 Det=377 Pri=0 Vec=0 VHld=0 VClr=0 SOvf=1 IrqE=1 GrpE=1 IRQ=1 VClm=1

```
Q1 (StatusRegister after RDVC = vector+1? on which chip?):
  HI Status 000 -> 000 (vector was 0, VClaim after=1/no-win)
  LO Status 000 -> 004 (vector was 3, VClaim after=0/WINS)
  -> the chip whose Status advanced to vector+1 is the one that supplied the vector;
     the other chip's Status (unchanged) shows the load is on the winner only.
Q2 (what gates the load - GroupEnable/LGE at that moment):
  HI GrpE=1 (before) / 1 (after)
  LO GrpE=0 (before) / 0 (after)
  Cross-reference GrpE against which chip's Status loaded to confirm whether LGE qualifies it.
